question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
WITH top_5_actors AS (
    SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) as film_count
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY actor_id
    ORDER BY film_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
films_with_top_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fa.film_id
    FROM film_actor fa
    INNER JOIN top_5_actors t5a ON fa.actor_id = t5a.actor_id
),
rentals_of_top_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.customer_id
    FROM rental r
    INNER JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    INNER JOIN films_with_top_actors fta ON i.film_id = fta.film_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as active_customers
    FROM customer
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentals_of_top_actors) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer), 2) as percentage
